top_stories.title: Claude Code leak exposes a Tamagotchi-style 'pet' and an always-on agent
top_stories.summary: A leak of Anthropic's Claude Code source code has revealed unreleased features including a Tamagotchi-style virtual pet and an always-on background agent. The Verge reports the leak offers a rare glimpse into Anthropic's near-term product roadmap for its developer-focused AI tools.

top_stories.title: I Asked ChatGPT What WIRED's Reviewers Recommend. Its Answers Were All Wrong
top_stories.summary: Wired tested ChatGPT by asking it to summarise the outlet's own product recommendations and found the answers were consistently inaccurate. The piece raises concerns about AI-generated misinformation in consumer contexts and the reliability of LLMs as information retrieval tools.

top_stories.title: Gradient Labs gives every bank customer an AI account manager
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has highlighted Gradient Labs, a startup using its models to deploy AI-powered account managers for bank customers. The announcement points to growing adoption of LLM-based agents in financial services for personalised customer interactions.

top_stories.title: AI benchmarks are broken. Here's what we need instead.
top_stories.summary: MIT Technology Review examines how existing AI benchmarks have become saturated and unreliable as measures of model capability, with leading models now scoring near-perfectly on tests designed to challenge them. Researchers and industry figures argue for new evaluation frameworks that better reflect real-world performance.

top_stories.title: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model: Bending the Inference Scaling Curve to Serve LLM-Scale Models for Ads
top_stories.summary: Meta's engineering blog details its Adaptive Ranking Model, which applies LLM-scale inference to its advertising systems while managing computational costs. The post outlines architectural innovations that allow Meta to run large models for ad ranking without a proportional increase in infrastructure expense.

further_links.title: You can now use ChatGPT with Apple's CarPlay
further_links.summary: OpenAI has integrated ChatGPT into Apple's CarPlay, allowing drivers to interact with the AI assistant hands-free while on the road.

further_links.title: Accelerating the next phase of AI
further_links.summary: OpenAI outlines its strategic vision for the next phase of AI development, emphasising infrastructure, model capability and deployment at scale.

further_links.title: Art schools are being torn apart by AI
further_links.summary: The Verge reports on deepening divisions inside art schools over generative AI, with faculty and students clashing over whether AI tools should be embraced or resisted in creative education.

further_links.title: The gig workers who are training humanoid robots at home
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review explores how a new gig economy is emerging around remote data collection for humanoid robot training, with workers performing physical tasks at home to generate training data.

further_links.title: The Download: AI health tools and the Pentagon's Anthropic culture war
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review's daily briefing covers the reliability of AI-powered health tools and reports on internal tensions at the Pentagon over its relationship with Anthropic.

further_links.title: Baidu's robotaxis froze in traffic, creating chaos
further_links.summary: Baidu's Apollo Go robotaxi service experienced a software failure that caused vehicles to stop in the middle of traffic in China, highlighting ongoing safety and reliability challenges for autonomous vehicle deployments.

further_links.title: You can order Grubhub and Uber Eats 'conversationally' with Alexa Plus
further_links.summary: Amazon's updated Alexa Plus now supports conversational food ordering through Grubhub and Uber Eats integrations, marking a step forward for AI-powered voice commerce.

further_links.title: AI Has Flooded All the Weather Apps
further_links.summary: Wired examines how AI-generated weather summaries and forecasts have proliferated across consumer weather apps, often without clear labelling or accuracy verification.

further_links.title: Shifting to AI model customization is an architectural imperative
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review argues that enterprises must treat AI model customisation as a core architectural decision rather than an optional add-on, as off-the-shelf models increasingly fail to meet specific business needs.

further_links.title: AI can push your Stream Deck buttons for you
further_links.summary: Elgato has updated the Stream Deck with MCP-based AI agent support, allowing AI models to trigger device actions automatically on behalf of users.

ethan_mollick.title: Claude Dispatch and the Power of Interfaces
ethan_mollick.summary: Ethan Mollick explores how the interface through which you interact with an AI model significantly shapes the quality and nature of the output you receive. Using Anthropic's Claude as a case study, he argues that thoughtful interface design can unlock capabilities that a bare chat window obscures.
